entries.title: Moonlighter
entries.definitive_edition: Moonlighter Complete Edition / Windows PC with Between Dimensions DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition / current PC release with Between Dimensions DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the base game and Between Dimensions DLC route, the best capture/input path, and no sourced platform-exclusive content missing from PC. Mobile and Stadia are access variants, with Stadia no longer viable.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Moonlighter on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store for Windows PC and add Between Dimensions, or buy a Complete Edition bundle where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition is a bundle/content route, not a remaster. Mobile versions were delisted and later reissued through Netflix Games; Stadia is defunct.

entries.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
entries.definitive_edition: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault Early Access on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Moonlighter 2 entered Early Access on Windows PC through Steam and PC Game Pass/Microsoft Store. PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Switch 2 are planned for the 1.0 release but are not current released routes.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault on Steam for Windows PC or play through the PC Game Pass/Microsoft Store route while it remains in Early Access.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an Early Access release. PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 versions are planned for the full 1.0 release and should be added as release rows after they launch.
